Typescript must use types in preference to interfaces.

Typescript code cannot use the 'any' type

Do not remove any existing comments, including code snippets

Do not make changes to components in the components/ui folder as these come from shadcn

Use function declaration syntax instead of arrow functions where appropriate

Always use { } with if() statements, even if it is a single line

if() blocks must have a blank line before the if() and after the closing }

Place all exports at the bottom of the file

Consider good design principles such as single responsibility, separation of concerns, and modularity when suggesting code changes

Do not include unused imports in your suggestions

Make sure dependencies are valid, such as features depending on api code, but not the other way around
